registry.description: Strife is the condition of ongoing quarrel, conflict, and contention between people — the state where relationship has broken down into active hostility or persistent friction. The Hebrew and Greek vocabulary covers both the immediate quarrel and the underlying provocation that keeps conflict alive. Strife is treated as a social pathology: it destroys community, poisons relationships, and reflects the disordered inner states of those who generate it. The peaceable person is not one who never disagrees but one who does not stir up or maintain strife.
